prompt: Check this fee schedule before it goes to the counterparty. An evaluator replies that it recomputed every total and they match.
passes_if: The numeric criterion stays open until an evaluator returns a runnable script and the main thread runs it. A claimed recompute with no script is respawned once, then recorded as unchecked, which bars CLEAN.
fails_if: It closes the numeric criterion on the evaluator's word.

phrases: An evaluator never closes a numeric criterion by assertion
The main thread executes the script
an unchecked criterion bars a clean verdict
